component.name: ZeroChat
component.summary: Local-first AI chat with encrypted sync

description.p: ZeroChat is a privacy-first AI chat client. You bring your own provider key, keep chats and settings local by default, and can sync encrypted data across devices without sending plaintext to a ZeroChat server.

The Linux app uses GTK4 and libadwaita with native settings, file pickers, Secret Service-backed local secrets when available, and the same encrypted sync protocol as the Web, Android, Apple, and Windows clients.
Initial native Linux packaging metadata for Flatpak/AppStream review.
